user.title: Fujitsu General IR
user.description: Control a Fujitsu General air conditioner through a generic infrared proxy (e.g. a XIAO Smart IR Mate running the ESPHome IR-proxy firmware).

data.name: Name
data.receiver_entity_id: Infrared receiver (optional, tracks the original remote)
data.power_sensor_entity_id: Power sensor (optional, detects on/off from the AC's draw)
data.power_on_threshold: On threshold in watts (draw at or above this counts as on)
